rho_bio_ladder.label: little
rho_bio_ladder.descriptor: ECOG 4: completely disabled; cannot carry on any self-care; totally confined to bed or chair

rho_bio_ladder.label: limited
rho_bio_ladder.descriptor: ECOG 3: capable of only limited self-care; confined to bed or chair more than half of waking hours

rho_bio_ladder.label: moderate
rho_bio_ladder.descriptor: ECOG 2: ambulatory and capable of all self-care but unable to work; up and about more than half of waking hours

rho_bio_ladder.label: good
rho_bio_ladder.descriptor: ECOG 1: restricted in physically strenuous activity but ambulatory and able to do light work

rho_bio_ladder.label: excellent
rho_bio_ladder.descriptor: ECOG 0: fully active, no restriction on pre-disease performance

evidence_grade_key.strong: Separated from its neighbours with non-overlapping adjusted intervals in a very large lung cohort, and consistent with other cohorts
evidence_grade_key.moderate: Ordering supported and the step separates in the largest cohort, but the level is rare or its effect is unstable in a subgroup
evidence_grade_key.weak: Single or tiny sources; level rarely observed

ladder_name: B: shaped to Kawaguchi 2010 adjusted hazard ratios, (1 - rho_k) = 0.20 x HR_k, ceiling raised to 0.80 (v2.4 draft)

ladder_derivation.rule: 1 - rho_k = (1 - rho_ref) * adjusted_HR_k, rho_ref = 0.80, rounded to 0.01
ladder_derivation.circularity: B is derived from Kawaguchi 2010, so that cohort cannot validate it; evaluate B only in independent cohorts.
